address: 26 rue de la République, Luzy, 58170, France
bio: In the walls of the Hôtel du Morvan, chef Jérôme Raymond plays a modern, culinary score based on regional produce. A single set menu, with more upmarket ingredients at the weekend (Charolais beef is a firm favourite). Whopping 400-bin wine list of mainly Burgundy origins. Comfortable rooms should you wish to stay longer....
